case.name: anti_join_after_points
case.sql: SELECT count(*),sum(x) FROM (SELECT length(t.payload) AS x FROM t LEFT JOIN u ON u.id=t.seq WHERE u.id IS NULL AND (t.grp=8 OR t.seq%8=0));
case.prepare: WITH RECURSIVE c(i) AS (VALUES(1) UNION ALL SELECT i+1 FROM c WHERE i<1000) SELECT sum((SELECT v FROM t WHERE id=printf('%016x', 1+(c.i*2654435761)%65536))) FROM c;
